description: Use when an agent needs a QR code for a link, address or payment string. Returns an SVG or PNG (base64 and data URI) at error-correction level M, scaled for scanning. Input up to 2 KB; over that is a 400, never billed. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
